declarations.comment:

A `DevicePairingView` should be used to become discoverable to local devices from the user through a button interface.

declarations.name: DevicePicker
declarations.signature: @MainActor @preconcurrency struct DevicePicker<Label, Fallback> where Label : View, Fallback : View
declarations.comment:
A control that allows a user to discover local devices with which to communicate.

An `DevicePicker` should be used to discover local devices from the user through a button interface.
On tvOS, this presents a fullscreen device picker experience when selected.
